claim.label: take-off speed
claim.provenance: S1 Table row c_21382_488 (Larva9): velocity.max = 0.405 m/s, VelError = 0.059. VelError is a relative error in the authors' R script (ratio formula), so +/- = 0.059 x 0.405 = 0.024 m/s. That the video jump is jump 488 is an inference: take-off angle, distance, height and airborne time all match that row (74.6 deg, 9.44 mm, 8.64 mm, 0.081 s).
